notes: Evangelical non-denominational church on the east side at Pantano and Broadway. Eric Naus is confirmed as Executive Pastor for Preaching - he teaches weekly - and is the right person to review first. The sermon archive is indexed by preacher (ccctucson.org/sermons/preacher/...), which makes attribution easy; other names seen in search snippets (Tim Sheaffer, Brett Inman, Joel Harris, Randy Reynolds, a 'Pastor Floyd') were NOT added because their roles and whether they still preach could not be confirmed - resolve them from the staff page. A sermon dated 2026-08-23 ('When Life Gets Comfortable') shows the archive is current.
